text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, looks like everyone is completely
swept up in the Valentine's Day excitement.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, naturally! It's an exciting event that comes but once a year!
How could one not be thrilled?
Are you not feeling the same, Pearl-san!?"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's not a confession to someone you like...
Wouldn't you give chocolates to someone
you want to become closer with?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, I'll be on the receiving end!
My poppy always used to say so.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Just like Poppy always gifts Mommy,
someday a wonderful person is sure
to give you a sweet present too!" she said!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"My, my! In Pearl-san's family,
the father gives presents to the mother!
That is simply wonderful too~!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Of course, Mommy gives plenty of love back in return too!
That's the American way!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ah. Then could it be... Pearl-san, is there already someone who gives you sweet presents like that...?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I had no idea~! Fufu! In that case, Pearl-san, you must shower them with love right back in full force!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, you're entirely right.
I am the one receiving those feelings...
I needed to prepare myself as well.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Mommy always kisses Daddy on the cheek...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, non!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
! What are you doing here!?
The real race is tomorrow! Jumping the gun like that,
do you need a starting gate of your own!?

I only happened to be passing by...
but I can't help staring at Seeking the Pearl, who is flustered in a way I've rarely seen.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Wh... Those eyes...! 
I understand. You have high expectations of me, don't you?
Naturally. It is only natural.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Still, think carefully about this.
Pappy and Mammy, you and me.
Our positions are different, aren't they?
choice_data_list: Um... what were you talking about—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"However, I am Seeking the Pearl!
As one who stands on the world stage,
I must always rise to meet expectations!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: ...Even more so since you're my partner, right?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Just you wait.
I'll prepare myself mentally by tomorrow...!

...Without explaining anything,
Seeking the Pearl left the room.
What on earth is going to happen tomorrow...?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! Well, what do you think?!
I believe this should be more than enough
to answer your feelings!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Don't you think this portion size
is very American as well!?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Like I said yesterday, we are an Umamusume and a Trainer! Given our positions, isn't this the best form of return gift!?

What was brought into the room
was a piece of chocolate too massive to even carry.
This is—
choice_data_list: Oh, could this be for Valentine's?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: "That's right! As a return for the present I received from you—..."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...
...I haven't gotten one yet, have I?
Could she have... been expecting a Valentine's gift from me?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...Oho-ho-ho-ho!
Looks like I was the one who jumped the gun!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Very well! Let's make this your way
of returning the favor to me!!
choice_data_list: O-Of course, I'll pay you back—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Now, can you come up with a return gift
worthy of this much chocolate!?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Come on, come on, let's go!!
I managed to calm down Seeking the Pearl as she closed in relentlessly, getting her to hold off on returning the favor for a while.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Trainer, this is...

Yesterday, after all that happened, I looked up
what day it was and realized.
—That's right, it was Valentine's Day.

It might not be high-end, but I got it ready.
It's chocolate in an eye-catching seashell case. I wonder if she'll like it.
choice_data_list: You were the first person who came to mind, so I went with this...
You were the first person who came to mind, so I went with this...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh my, what a dilemma.
This truly is a fabulous item."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: "I was thinking of giving you a hug in return... but looking at this, that simply won't be enough, will it?"
choice_data_list: If it made you happy, then that's enough for me...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Non!!!!! For the great Seeking the Pearl
to merely receive something is
absolutely out of the question!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
However, with who I am right now, I have nothing to give in return...
Ugh, how could this be?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: ...I see. In that case, I will definitely return the favor for this Valentine's in the future!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Umamusume and Trainer.
What we can do within this relationship
right now may be limited, but—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The future! The future!
The possibilities are completely unknown, after all!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Wash your neck and wait for me!
Ho-ho-ho-ho!
I thought about mentioning that 'wash your neck' wasn't quite the right phrase, but decided to keep quiet. Seeking the Pearl turned to the side and continued to laugh heartily, but—

Was it just my imagination that her cheeks,
partly hidden by her hair, seemed faintly blushed?
